name: Dice Game
source:
In a university lab, nine men and women gather to play a game known as "The Matchmaking Game."
The rules are simple.
Roll the dice in turn and follow the instructions that come up.
As the game unfolds, hidden feelings spill out one after the other.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ258016.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
在大学实验室里，九名男女聚集在一起玩一种名为“配对游戏”的游戏。
规则很简单。
依次掷骰子并按照出现的说明进行操作。
随着游戏的展开，隐藏的感情也随之涌现。
